theme: 美股·板块与地域收入分布：谷歌A财年收入结构拆解（板块占比/地域收入），话题切换至波音全年营收

initial.question: 帮我查下谷歌A 2025财年按板块拆的销售收入，主营业务这一块是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT F007N FROM VIEW_COM3105 WHERE FIU_ID=(SELECT FIU_ID FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN WHERE CSNAME='谷歌A') AND F001D='2025-12-31' AND SECTOR_CNAME='主营业务'

feedbacks.question: 主营业务占它各板块收入合计的比例大概多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN SECTOR_CNAME='主营业务' THEN F007N ELSE 0 END)/SUM(F007N)*100,2) AS pct FROM VIEW_COM3105 WHERE FIU_ID=(SELECT FIU_ID FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN WHERE CSNAME='谷歌A') AND F001D='2025-12-31'

feedbacks.question: 同期它在北美市场实现的销售收入呢？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT v.F007N FROM VIEW_COM3106 v JOIN AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN m ON v.FIU_ID=m.FIU_ID WHERE m.CSNAME='谷歌A' AND v.F001D='2025-12-31' AND v.REGION_CNAME='北美'

feedbacks.question: 往回看一个财年，2024年主营业务板块这块做了多少收入？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT F007N FROM VIEW_COM3105 WHERE FIU_ID=(SELECT FIU_ID FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN WHERE CSNAME='谷歌A') AND F001D='2024-12-31' AND SECTOR_CNAME='主营业务'

feedbacks.question: 再把最新披露财年它在各地域的销售收入从高到低拉个清单
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT v.REGION_CNAME, v.F007N FROM VIEW_COM3106 v JOIN AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN m ON v.FIU_ID=m.FIU_ID WHERE m.CSNAME='谷歌A' AND v.F001D=(SELECT MAX(F001D) FROM VIEW_COM3106 WHERE FIU_ID=v.FIU_ID) ORDER BY v.F007N DESC

feedbacks.question: 换个标的，波音2025财年全年的营业收入总共是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT F048N FROM COM3103 WHERE FIU_ID=(SELECT FIU_ID FROM AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN WHERE CSNAME='波音') AND F001D='2025-12-31' AND F003V='FY'
